volunteer_work_order_view_same_role_time: Same role, times and capacity, on a later date. A weekly slot is 7.
volunteer_work_order_view_shift_updated_: Shift updated. Everyone on it stays on it.
volunteer_work_order_view_taken_off_plac: Taken off. The place is open again.
volunteer_work_order_view_their_place_op: Their place opens up straight away. Use this when they gave you notice — a no-show is for somebody who simply didn't turn up.
volunteer_work_order_view_they_ll_get_re: They'll get a reminder the day before. Only confirmed claims complete automatically afterwards, so this is what turns a claim into a booking.
volunteer_work_order_view_use_when_reach: Use this when you reached them another way. Nothing is sent — it just takes them off the list.
volunteer_work_order_view_wait_today_me_: Wait on Today for me to confirm
